name: RoboNet for Haru
tagline: Calling portal and real-time server for Honda Research Institute's Haru robot platform
role: Backend and web portal by the Softwhere team for Honda Research Institute

scenes.title: Sign-in backed by AWS Cognito
scenes.body: Amplify signs users in against a Cognito user pool; the NestJS API verifies every access token.

scenes.title: Contacts with live presence
scenes.body: Status badges on every contact; pick one of four states, from Keen to meet to Not available.

scenes.title: Haru and Clara devices per user
scenes.body: Devices linked through the desktop app report Online or Offline and can be renamed or disconnected.

scenes.title: A callbook of every call
scenes.body: Incoming, outgoing and missed calls grouped by day, with durations and a call-back action.

scenes.title: Answer calls from the browser
scenes.body: Call events arrive over Server-Sent Events; the NestJS server also relays WebRTC signaling between devices.
